note: 'roles' is a DISTRIBUTION: p(role | this species appears), because the same species is support on one set and offensive on another. A role is listed only when its Wilson lower bound clears rate_floor, so a 2-in-3566 fluke is excluded while a genuine minor set is kept. 'all_roles' keeps every observed rate with its interval, for audit.
capability_note: 'capability' is a REACHABILITY SET from Smogon usage, not a rate: can this species play this role at all. Mega formes are folded onto the base name because team preview shows the base -- 0 of 58,920 clean team-preview names is a mega forme, so mega abilities are unobservable from replays. Use 'roles' for how a species is usually played; use 'capability' for what a team could do. 'capability_from' names the Smogon row each role came from.
